cases.study_information: Predict the terminal beta-elimination half-life (hours) of HER2_trimer and HER2_negative_trimer. The HER2 monomer reference is visible. The constructs are one copy or three copies joined by 5-amino-acid flexible linkers; none contains an Fc. Negative charge engineering retained HER2 binding with an approximately 1.8-fold KD change versus the unmodified trimer. The experiment used six-week-old female BALB/c mice, 100 µg IP and terminal sampling through 24 hours, with selected trimer observations to 48 hours. Predict observed beta-phase persistence, not IV clearance.

dependence_note: Shared experimental family; count in original-family sensitivity aggregation, not as independent biological replication.
title: Predicting HER2 nanobody persistence after multimerization and charge engineering
